stem.text: The diagram shows a metal block.

stem.alt: Metal block drawn in perspective, with a current I entering the left side and leaving the right side. Dimensions a, b and c are marked along its edges.

stem.text: The block has sides of length $a$, $b$ and $c$ as shown, and its volume is $V$. Each charge carrier has a charge $-q$ and the number density of the charge carriers in the metal is $n$. It takes each charge carrier an average time of $t$ to pass through the block.
What is an expression for the current $I$?
